validation_log.message: Independent main-article inventory covers Tables 1-4, Figure 1 directly printed labels, footnotes and quantified Results text.
All 16 Table 3 SE values are present and classified as SE, not SD.
All 10 arm-level log-analysis percentage changes are present; published effects are retained separately.
HbA1c effects are ODDS_RATIO and cardiovascular time-to-event effects are HAZARD_RATIO.
No p-value is fabricated after the failed cardiovascular-death hierarchy gate.
Sex and race are characteristics; male/female and reported race categories are in separate subgroup cells.
HbA1c outcome names contain no operator; <, =, >, threshold value and unit occupy separate cells before outcome-measure fields.
Each distinct arm, outcome, subgroup and timepoint is represented once; repeated source occurrences are provenance, not duplicate observations.
Only directly printed Figure 1 number-at-risk labels are extracted; curves are not digitized or treated as exact values.
The supplementary appendix was not supplied; no supplementary numbers are reported.
